events.title: Movement & Light: Barbara Morgan Lecture Presented by John Fergus-Jean
events.description: Join John Fergus-Jean, Emeritus Professor of Photography Columbus College of Art and Design & CTAC Board Chair, for an in-depth discussion and guided tour of Modern Movement: Martha Graham and Barbara Morgan. Explore the life and work of pioneering photographer Barbara Morgan, whose iconic images helped define the visual language of modern dance. Learn about the history of her photography, the artistic and cultural context in which she worked, and the stories behind the works featured in the exhibition. This engaging tour offers a deeper understanding of Morgan's enduring impact on photography and the performing arts.

events.description: Ken Dinkins is a longtime Northern Michigan musician, songwriter, recording artist, arranger, and producer whose career in music spans more than five decades. events.title: Discover What Drives You with Predictive Index, a 20Fathoms Breakfast Lab
events.description: This Week at Breakfast Lab What if a six-minute assessment could show you exactly how you work best? Join certified coach and Predictive Index Partner Shea Petaja for an interactive session on the PI Behavioral Assessment, a science-based tool that shows how your natural behavior shapes the way you work. It’s just two questions and takes about six minutes, and you’ll be amazed by how accurately it describes you. You’ll gain a clearer understanding of how you: Connect and communicate with others Take charge and make decisions Handle change, pace, and pressure Manage details and follow through (or don’t!) Stay motivated, and what drains you Plus, find out which of the 17 PI Reference Profiles you are. Shea will walk you through your personal results. You’ll see your strengths in a new light and spot the blind spots that may be holding you back. Expect a lively conversation with real connection and direct, personalized feedback. Before You Come: Please complete the assessment before attending. Shea will print your results and bring them so you can review them together and get instant feedback. Take the assessment here: PI Behavioral Assessment About the Presenter Shea Petaja is a strategic advisor and certified executive coach based in Traverse City. With 15 years in finance, including a stint as chief experience officer at a nationally recognized advisory firm, she helps founders and leadership teams uncover their strengths and communicate them clearly. She’s a certified Predictive Index partner and Enneagram-trained, with 12 years of coaching leaders behind her. Shea also co-created Fulfillament, a live storytelling event that ran for seven years, and has coached more than 100 entrepreneurs on telling their stories from the stage. She hosts the podcast The Honest Edge . About Breakfast Lab Breakfast Lab is a weekly event at 20Fathoms where you’ll get expert guidance to help meet your most pressing startup needs. Connecting you to the right tools and the right people at the right time. These events are held in person and offered virtually. There is no cost to attend. Coffee and a light breakfast are provided. Walk-ins are welcome. And if you’d like to stay and keep working, coworking at 20Fathoms is free on Thursdays for Breakfast Lab attendees.

events.title: Startup Coaching: Virtual
events.description: Happens every Thursday by appointment. Just show up and bring your questions! Connect with startup experts who can help you grow. Startup coaches share their time, wisdom, and connect ions to help entrepreneurs build successful businesses and avoid common mistakes. They can provide guidance to entrepreneurs with new and growing businesses on a full range of topics including business planning and entity formation, funding strategy, sales, operations, human resources, and much more. New business owners routinely state that mentorship and connections are very important. However, entrepreneurs must be open and committed to learning, as well as willing to make the time to meet with their coach. To better serve our regional entrepreneurs, 20Fathoms now offers access to coaching virtually! Virtual coaching is open to all by appointment. Schedule an appointment. What to expect: For your small business, startup, or idea A private, one-on-one meeting with a startup expert Troubleshoot your business goals and challenges Honest, supportive feedback Recommendations on resources and tools

events.title: Build Guild : Traverse City @ Earthen Ales
events.description: Build Guild Traverse City We’re a fun, friendly gathering for web people of all sorts — developers, designers, producers, friends of people whose nephew makes websites on weekends. We’ll probably be a bit geeky, we want you to be too. All are welcome to Build Guild. Some attendees bring their significant others from time to time, and we’ve even seen a couple kids (if your venue allows it). We just want people that want to be there. There are no talks, no presentations, and no topics forced upon people to discuss. People show up, they grab a drinks if they want one, find a hand to shake are start chatting. Build Guild is a low-to-no-pressure environment. People do network with one another at Build Guilds, but it’s not your typical networking event. It’s low-key, laid-back, and much more focused on sharing stories over a beer than a business-card free-for-all. We’ve had the occasional pushy recruiter show up here and there, but ten minutes and a beer later, they’re laid back just like everyone else. Build Guild provides the least amount of structure needed to get people regularly chatting with one another face-to-face.
